description: I am fully responsible for the life that I live and don’t expect others to manage me #selfmanagement #selflove #selfimprovement
transcript: I maintain healthy relationships because I outsource all of my needs, I have a nutritionist, I have a therapist, I have a personal shopper, I have a family planner, I have all the things that I need in order to be fully present. I am responsible for myself, so I'm responsible for the way that I show up in relationships, I have no expectations for anyone. Yes, I have standards of how I like to move throughout various relationships and they are interchangeable. Fun, I'm responsible for me and my life and I don't expect the people around me to be.
